result.note: The fire itself is an accident story, so the question tests the durable fact of which local crude the new Balotra refinery is built to process.

questions.prompt: The HPCL Rajasthan Refinery (HRRL) at Balotra, scheduled for inauguration by the Prime Minister in April 2026, is designed to process crude oil from which domestic source?
questions.explain: HRRL is designed to process local Mangala crude and produce high-value petrochemicals, helping India cut its import dependency. A fire broke out at the facility on 20 April 2026, a day before the scheduled inauguration, but it was brought under control with no casualties.
questions.source: HRRL aims to help the country slash import dependency by processing local Mangala crude and producing high-value petrochemicals.
